title: Listeners by country
statementMd:
Plays per listener country, most first.

Expected columns: `country`, `plays`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT l.country, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM plays p JOIN listeners l ON l.id = p.listener_id GROUP BY l.country ORDER BY plays DESC, l.country;
```
